evidence: Touches connection management and transport enforcement in src/net.cpp and src/net.h, labeled P2P.
rationale: Adds the `-v2onlyclearnet` configuration option to prevent plaintext v1 fallback and protect against passive on-path eavesdroppers on clearnet connections. Resolves long-standing issue #29618 and provides meaningful user-facing privacy improvements for node operators desiring strict v2 transport.
